name: Phil Carlos
intro: Hi, I’m Phil — a curious AI builder and designer.
about: My exploration began with architectural design and gradually moved toward the intersection of AIGC, interaction design, and the internet.
I enjoy thinking through complex problems, breaking them down, and understanding the patterns behind them, working with AI to turn ideas into coherent results that I can build on and reuse.
This is my personal site, where I document my life, thoughts, projects, and practice. Some come from independent exploration; others are made with collaborators.
interest: Outside of vibe coding, I spend time wandering, exploring through travel and photography, and hoping to connect with more people. I want to learn more about the real world beyond the screen, in all its tangible, vivid detail.
sponsor: If something I share is useful to you, you are welcome to buy me a coffee. Thank you.
